name: Polaris USD
oneLiner: pUSD is Polaris's pre-launch Liquity-style CDP stablecoin minted against pETH; a Stability Pool routes borrower interest and liquidation flows to holders.
collateral: pETH / ETH-derived collateral posted in Polaris CDPs, with protocol revenue and liquidation flows routed to pUSD Stability Pool participants rather than offchain reserve yield
pegMechanism: Pre-launch Liquity-style CDP stablecoin: borrowers post pETH collateral to mint pUSD, undercollateralized positions are liquidated through a Stability Pool, and pUSD holders can earn borrower-interest and liquidation-flow yield once runtime sources are live

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed No: pUSD is pre-launch/testnet-only, and Polaris describes a CDP/Stability Pool design using pETH collateral and protocol flows rather than an issuer-managed token with a holder freeze/blacklist surface.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Suppresses a resolver same-symbol/text false positive. This Polaris entry is scoped to the holder-facing pre-launch pUSD asset; pETH is documented as immutable ETH-wrapper collateral, and no live upstream freezable token is identified.

launchPhaseDetail: Public testnet open on Sepolia (connect via app.testnet.polarisfinance.io); security review in progress with professional audits upcoming per the site roadmap; mainnet date uncommitted — polarisfinance.io explicitly states no date is set and prioritises security over speed, so the earlier 2026-Q4 expectation was retired on 2026-08-05. Public comms (blog and press) quiet since late April 2026 while testnet infrastructure remains live.

featuredContent.title: pUSD: No Counterparty, No Ceiling
featuredContent.description: How pUSD delivers counterparty-free yield that scales alongside protocol adoption and the developing ecosystem supporting it.

featuredContent.title: Sustaining the Ecosystem: pETH & pUSD Flows
featuredContent.description: Polaris replaces emission-based incentives with an autonomous protocol-revenue distribution mechanism that flows to participants based on their asset holdings — no governance-driven allocation, no bribery.

featuredContent.title: The Path to the North Star
featuredContent.description: TokenBrice traces Polaris's origins from Robert Lauko's bonding-curve research to today's three-pillar mission: counterparty-free yield, ETH-correlated alternatives, and restoring DeFi credibility against a backdrop where only $184.79M of the $338.9B stablecoin supply is non-freezable.
